description: This file contains a Scala class 'RqlPredicateParser' that implements a parser for the RQL language, specifically parsing predicate expressions into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). It defines parsing rules for various RQL constructs such as comparisons, logical operations, and existence checks, and includes a companion object for parsing input strings into the AST.

classes.name: RqlPredicateParser
classes.description: A parser class that extends 'RqlParserBase' to parse RQL predicate strings into an AST.

classes.name: RootNode
classes.description: The root node for the AST representing the parsed RQL predicate.

methods.name: PredicateRoot
methods.description: Entry point for parsing the root of an RQL predicate input.

methods.name: Query
methods.description: Parses different types of RQL queries, including comparisons, logical operations, and existence checks.

methods.name: SingleComparisonOp
methods.description: Parses a single comparison operation in RQL.

methods.name: SingleComparisonName
methods.description: Parses the name/type of a comparison operator (e.g., 'eq', 'ne').

methods.name: MultiComparisonOp
methods.description: Parses multi-value comparison operations, such as 'in'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Public method to parse a string input into an RQL AST.
